settings.private_audience_label: When a member makes their profile private, who can view it?
settings.private_audience_help: This determines the scope of the member's privacy switch. When the switch is off, the selected profile pages are public.
settings.audience_private: Profile owner and authorized staff only
settings.forced_visibility_help: Enforced for every member. Members cannot change this visibility in their account settings.
settings.member_mode_help: Members can turn 'Make my profile private' on or off in their account settings. You decide who can still view the selected profile pages when they turn it on.
settings.member_scope_help: Choose 'Signed-in members' to hide private profiles from guests only, or 'Profile owner and authorized staff only' to hide them from guests and other members. Owners, administrators and users with bypass permission retain access.
settings.admin_mode_help: Your visibility selection applies to every member, regardless of their personal privacy choice. The privacy switch is hidden from member settings in this mode.
settings.preferences_preserved: Changing modes does not erase member privacy choices. Saved choices apply again when you return to 'Members decide'.
settings.visibility_scope: Visibility levels apply only to the profile pages selected in the other two tabs. Avatars and profile headers remain visible.
settings.visibility_everyone: Guests and signed-in members can view the selected profile pages.
settings.visibility_members: Only signed-in members can view the selected profile pages. Guests see a message asking them to log in.
settings.visibility_private: Only the profile owner, administrators, and users with the bypass profile visibility permission can view the selected profile pages.
settings.hidden_tabs_help: Choose which tabs follow profile visibility restrictions. Unselected tabs, avatars and the profile header remain visible. Posts and discussions are selected by default.
settings.discovering_tabs: Discovering profile tabs from the forum…
settings.discovery_complete: Profile tabs are up to date.
settings.discovery_failed: Profile tabs could not be refreshed. Please try again.
settings.api_supported_help: These profile pages and their supported API queries are protected by profile visibility settings. Select the pages you want to protect.
settings.api_unsupported_help: These pages can be hidden on profiles, but API protection is not yet supported. Their data may still be accessible through the extensions' APIs.
settings.no_tabs: No profile pages were found in this group.
settings.api_request: Want API protection for another extension? Request support by leaving a comment in the Private Profile discussion. Please include the extension name and a link to its page.

settings.private_profile_help: Choose who can view the profile tabs selected by the administrator. Your avatar and profile header remain visible. You and users with bypass permission retain access.
settings.private_profile_help_members: When enabled, only signed-in members can view the profile pages selected by the administrator. Guests will be asked to log in.
settings.private_profile_help_private: When enabled, only you, administrators and users with bypass permission can view the profile pages selected by the administrator.
settings.private_profile_help_public: When disabled, these profile pages are public. Your avatar and profile header remain visible in either case.

forum.profile_members_only: This profile is visible to members only. Please log in to view.
